panels.description: The number of policies held by each PDP instance.
panels.title: Policy Count

panels.description: The distribution of the times required to evaluate the policies for incoming requests across all selected PDP instances.
panels.title: Engine Evaluation Duration

panels.description: The distribution of the times required to service all incoming requests across all selected PDP instances
panels.title: RPC Call Duration

panels.description: Requests to the Check method can include more than one request request to evaluate. This shows the distribution of the number of policy evaluations in each incoming request for all selected instances.
panels.title: Check Method Batch Sizes

panels.description: The aggregate RPC latency for the selected instances.
panels.title: RPC Latency Percentiles

panels.description: The Check evaluation latency percentiles for the selected instances.
panels.title: Check Latency Percentiles

panels.description: Percentiles for the time take to compile policies for the selected instances.
panels.title: Compile Compilation Time  Percentiles

panels.description: This is the total request rate by RPC method and response status, for all selected instances.
panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: The total number of requests handled by each of the selected instancecs.
panels.title: Request Rate by Instance

panels.description: The number of errors reported for each RPC by each selected instance. Not that some things reported as errors, such as CANCELLED, may not reflect an actual error within the PDP.
panels.title: Error Rate

panels.description: The total number of errors returned by each of the selected instances.
panels.title: Error Rate - by instance

panels.description: This shows the percentage of the internal cache used for each of the selected instances.
panels.title: Cache (${cache_kinds})

panels.description: This shows the hit and miss rate  of the internal cache for each of the selected instances.
panels.title: Cache Access (${cache_kinds})

panels.description: This is the total resident memory in use by each instance.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: This shows the rate of memory allocation operations performed by the Go runtime for each of the selected instances. More metrics related to the nature of the memory use of the PDP are exposed than are presented here.
panels.title: Allocations

panels.description: The time spent in "stop the world" garbage collection for all selected instances.
panels.title: Garbage Collection Pause Time

panels.description: This is the amount of CPU being used by each selected instance. This is as reported by the instance itself. Alternative CPU measurements from your operating system may be more accurate.
panels.title: CPU Usage

panels.description: The number of active Go user space threads
panels.title: Go routines

panels.description: This is the number of active CPU threads allocated by the Go runtime
panels.title: Go Threads

panels.description: This is the network traffic level of each instance, as reported by the instance itself. Other systems may be able to provide a more accurate measurement.
panels.title: Network Traffic

panels.description: The total number of file descriptors in use by each instance.
panels.title: Open File Descriptors
